# Midtown Afnan & Dania

> Afnan and Dania are the first two districts of Midtown, a gated residential community in Dubai Production City, Dubai. Together they comprise 13 mid-rise buildings, ranging from seven to 18 levels, holding 1,238 studio to three-bedroom apartments. The two districts share more than 30,000 square feet of retail space, along with landscaped courtyards, swimming pools, gyms and children's play areas, close to Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Dubai Production City, UAE
- Status: Completed
- Year: 2020

## MENASCO Scope

Midtown is Deyaar's master-planned residential community in Dubai Production City. This package covered the Afnan and Dania districts: 13 buildings made up of four G+M+16, three G+M+8 and six G+M+7 blocks, with around 1,240 apartments between them. MENASCO carried out the MEP works across both districts, which were handed over in 2019 and 2020.
